rule: 每个主账号一次免费体验：控制台「模型广场」右上角“新用户福利免费体验”或「开通管理」页左上角免费体验卡片“领取免费资源”，弹窗勾选模型后立即领取；支持免费体验的模型首次调用时平台自动领取，每个账号每个模型仅可领取一次。免费额度在主账号维度生效、同一账号下所有模型共享，不可转让、不可叠加、不可兑换现金——多模型标称 100 万不按模型数量相加，账本保守只计一份。本期发放截至 2026-12-31（后续以页面或平台公告为准）；有效期自领取时起算，到期未用部分自动失效：语言模型与多模态理解模型均 100 万 Tokens、1 年，视觉包按原单位积分（视频生成 50 积分；3D 生成官方体验包表列型号——混元生3D：HY-3D-3.0、HY-3D-3.1、HY-3D-Express、HY-3D-Component、HY-3D-Format、HY-3D-Motion、HY-3D-Retopology、HY-3D-Rigging、HY-3D-Texture、HY-3D-UV——各 100 积分，均 1 年）。调用优先消耗免费额度；免费额度用尽后未开启后付费则服务自动停止，仅在「在线推理」页主动开启后付费后才继续可用：按 Token 计价的型号（语言、图像生成及多数视频系列）按 Token 用量计费、后付费小时结；按积分计价的型号（如 YT 系列视频生成）按积分计费、后付费日结，各模型系列积分独立计算、不互通（详见官方模型价格文档）。
value_en: Tencent Cloud TokenHub new-user free trial with shared main-account quota: all language models and all multimodal-understanding models each carry a 1,000,000-token free allowance valid for one year; visual free packs are denominated in credits (video generation YT-Video-HumanActor 50 credits; each model listed in the official 3D-generation trial table 100 credits; all one year). Claim via the Models Square or Open Management console dialogs, or automatically on a supported model's first call; distribution for this round runs through December 31, 2026.
rule_en: One free trial per main account: open the console Models Square page and click the top-right "New-user free trial" banner, or open the Open Management page and click "Claim free resources" on the top-left free-trial card, then check models in the dialog and claim; models supporting the free trial are auto-claimed on the first call, and each account may claim each model only once. Free allowances take effect at the main-account level and are shared by all models under the same account — non-transferable, non-stackable, non-redeemable for cash — so nominal 1M-per-model figures are never summed by model count and the ledger counts one pack conservatively. Distribution for this round ends December 31, 2026 (extensions per the page or platform announcements); validity starts at claim time and unused amounts expire: language and multimodal-understanding models each carry 1M tokens for one year, and visual packs keep their native credit unit (video generation 50 credits; the 3D-generation models listed in the official trial table — Hunyuan 3D: HY-3D-3.0, HY-3D-3.1, HY-3D-Express, HY-3D-Component, HY-3D-Format, HY-3D-Motion, HY-3D-Retopology, HY-3D-Rigging, HY-3D-Texture, HY-3D-UV — 100 credits each; one year each). Calls consume the free allowance first; once it is exhausted the service stops automatically unless postpaid billing is on, and only after you actively enable postpaid on the Online Inference page can calls continue: token-priced models (language, image generation and most video series) are billed per token usage with hourly postpaid settlement, while credit-priced models (such as YT-series video generation) are billed in credits with daily postpaid settlement, and credits are computed independently per model series and never interchangeable (see the official Model Pricing document).

rule: 需订阅并配置账单，仅限编码Agent流量；付费模型共享一个百分比额度，不能叠加：5小时=月额20%，每周=月额50%（周一 00:00 UTC 重置），月额随新付费账期重置。每模型月上限为整月仅用该模型时的账期覆盖额；请求数为官方估算，非保证；Extra Usage 开启后超额转按量余额扣费（Go Teams 默认开启），或改用免费模型。
value_en: OpenCode Go: $10/month. GLM-5.3's current monthly usage limits are $200 on Go and $400 on Go Plus (the limited-time $500/$1,000 boost expired November 22 and no longer appears on official pages). Go Teams costs $20/member/month with a 2-member minimum, each member's limits $5/month higher than Go.
rule_en: Subscription, billing and coding-agent traffic required. Paid models share one percentage allowance and limits do not add: the 5-hour limit is 20% of the monthly allowance, the weekly limit is 50% (resetting Mondays 00:00 UTC), and the monthly allowance resets with each new paid period. Each model's monthly limit is what the plan covers if you use only that model for the month. Request counts are official estimates, not guarantees. With Extra Usage on, requests past the limits fall back to the pay-as-you-go balance (on by default for Go Teams), or you can switch to free models.
